constraintBuilder.derivedEmpty: No session kind is marked {type} yet, so this rule has nothing to apply to and will not be sent to the scheduler. Set a kind’s type to {type} and it takes effect.

constraintBuilder.presetScoped: A scoped variant of this rule. Scope it below, then save.

constraintBuilder.severityHardHint: A breach is a defect. Surfaced as a violation; manual edits are warned, never blocked.
constraintBuilder.severityHardOption: Hard: a breach is a defect
constraintBuilder.severitySoftHint: A preference. The solver weighs it against the others rather than refusing.
constraintBuilder.tenantWide: Every session kind: this is the tenant-wide rule.
constraintBuilder.typeFixed: Cannot be changed. Create a new constraint instead.
constraintBuilder.weightHelp: Relative to your other enabled soft rules, not an absolute score. See below.
constraintBuilder.weightNoteBody: A weight only means something next to the other enabled soft rules: at 5 against rules weighted 100, this one will barely influence the result, while at 5 against rules weighted 1 it will dominate them. Multiplying every weight by the same number changes nothing at all. There is no ceiling and no "correct" value: pick a number that reflects this rule's importance {relative}, and raise it if the schedule is not respecting it enough.
constraintBuilder.weightNoteRelative: relative to your other active rules
